# Motivo

> Motivo is a mobile app with a friendly AI companion that helps you reach any goal, such as learning a skill, building a habit or finishing a project. It turns a goal into small daily steps, reminds you when it is time, and adapts when you miss a day. It is coming soon for iPhone and Android and is not in the app stores yet. Free to use, with an optional Pro subscription. Made by Magpy.
